starting-off.speaker: King Lathas
starting-off.text: And to you adventurer. I assume you're here about King Tyras?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Well, as we've previously discussed, my brother is currently gathering strength in the lands west of here. The only known way into those lands is through the Underground Pass.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Unfortunately, the pass is a treacherous place. Some of my best soldiers have fallen trying to find a way though.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: To make matters worse, some crazed group of cultists has recently made their home in the pass. Their leader, some madman named Iban, claims to be the son of Zamorak himself.

steps.player: Well that doesn't sound good. So what do you need from me?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: If my brother is to be stopped, a way through the Underground Pass must be found. This is the task I have for you. Do you think you're up for it?

steps.player: There's only one way to find out. Where do I start?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: You'll find the entrance to the Underground Pass at the far end of West Ardougne. My main tracker, Koftik, will meet you there.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Together, you are to find a way through the pass. Once you have done so, return to me.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Remember, the Underground Pass is lethal. Go prepared with food and armour or you won't last long.

steps.player: It sounds too dangerous for me. I'd better prepare more first.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Very well. Return to me when you are ready.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Fair enough. Return to me when you are ready and we will discuss our next steps.

starting-off-talking-to-king-lathas-agai.speaker: King Lathas
starting-off-talking-to-king-lathas-agai.text: And to you adventurer. Have you found a way through the Underground Pass yet?

starting-off-talking-to-king-lathas-agai.speaker: King Lathas
starting-off-talking-to-king-lathas-agai.text: Well keep at it. Come to me when you have something to report.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.player: Hello there, you must be Koftik.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.text: That I am adventurer. King Lathas told me to expect you. I assume he has told you our goal?

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.player: He said we need to find a way through the Underground Pass. Shouldn't be too bad, I've travelled through many a cave in my time.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.text: These caves are different... There is a darkness in there unlike any other. You can feel it as you wind your way round the stalagmites... an icy chill that penetrates the very fabric of your being...

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.text: I have. I didn't go far though, nor did I stay for long. People change in these caves...

steps.speaker: Koftik
steps.text: Okay traveller, I'll catch up with you by the bridge.

steps.speaker: Koftik
steps.text: I remember one warrior. His name was Randas. He stood tall and proud like an elven king...

steps.speaker: Koftik
steps.text: That same pride made him vulnerable. Randas' worthy desire to be a great and mighty warrior also made him corruptible.

steps.speaker: Koftik
steps.text: Within the cave, he heard the voice of Zamorak himself...

steps.speaker: Koftik
steps.text: Zamorak showed him a way to achieve his goals by appealing to that most base and dark nature... One that resides in all of us.

steps.speaker: Koftik
steps.text: No one knows...

steps.speaker: Koftik
steps.text: Anyway, head on in when you're ready. You'll soon come to a bridge, I will catch up with you there.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.player: Hello. What are you up to?

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.text: Nothing exciting, just keeping an eye out.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.text: I'm afraid not. This is the furthest I've ever been. It does look like someone was here before us though, there's the remains of a camp.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.text: I had a look through their things and found some cloth along with the charred remains of some arrows.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.player: Charred arrows? They must have been trying to burn something. Or someone!

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.speaker: Koftik

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: Eating me... they keep eating me! Eating me from the inside! Please stop them! I can feel them wriggling around inside me right now... please stop them!

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: Blood, blood... never enough blood to go round. When I lift up my arm like this, it all pours back into my body.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: I hope it remembers to go back inside my arm. And don't even ask me about my legs... how much blood are they going to need?

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: Blood is important. We must offer it to Zamorak every day as proof of our devotion. I just hope I don't run out!

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: Oh yes, you're a fine one. Nice red cheeks, shiny hair.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: Let's see now, some potatoes, some cabbage... Maybe half a clove of garlic...

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: Yes I think you'd make a fine soup. You don't mind do you?

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: You're welcome to have some with me of course...

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp? GBPP DNG SKTD DELP!

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: Kill the villagers, burn them all... every last one! I want nothing to survive... nothing but the sweet smell of burning flesh...

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: What's that? You've never smelt it before? Well, let's just say that it's an acquired taste...

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: Danger, everywhere danger! But not from man nor beast! This is the danger that is inside you.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: Bring it out, nurture it, cherish it. Stroke it like you would stroke a wounded bird... then strangle it before it takes hold of your very being. Don't say I didn't warn you.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: What's that... Is that a dagger I see before me? Why should I bear the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.speaker: Slave
the-underground-pass-talking-to-the-slav.text: For what is a man but this quintessence of dust? And so I say goodnight sweet prince. The rest is silence.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.text: The voices, they've been telling me things...

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.player: Koftik, is everything okay? You're getting me worried.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.text: Don't be friend. Anyway, do you know the definition of insanity?

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.text: The definition of insanity is doing the same thing over and over, expecting things to change.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.text: I spent years doing the same thing, day in and day out. I always wanted more but I never got it. Now, I finally see why...

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.text: You see, once I was insane. But now... now I am finally free...

the-underground-pass-speaking-to-any-of-.speaker: Sir Jerro
the-underground-pass-speaking-to-any-of-.text: Nor were we traveller. What are you doing in this most unholy place?

the-underground-pass-speaking-to-any-of-.player: I'm looking for a safe route through these caverns, under order of King Lathas.

the-underground-pass-speaking-to-any-of-.speaker: Sir Jerro
the-underground-pass-speaking-to-any-of-.text: Ah, the king tasked us with the same mission. Alas, a little further on lies the great doors of Iban. We've tried everything, but we cannot enter.

the-underground-pass-speaking-to-any-of-.speaker: Sir Jerro
the-underground-pass-speaking-to-any-of-.text: Anyway, you've done well to get this far traveller. Here eat...

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.text: Ah, you've arrived. We've been waiting for you.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.player: Koftik, you're still here? You should leave.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.text: Leave? But this is my home now. Home with my lord. He talks to me, he's my friend.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.player: Koftik, you really should leave these caverns.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.text: Not now, we're all the same down here. There's just you and those dwarves left.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.text: Foolish dwarves, still believing that they can resist. No one resists Iban.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.text: You could help! Deep down you know you want it! I know you already dealt with those Paladins. Now you just need to kill the dwarves!

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-i.text: Head south and through the tunnel. You'll find the dwarves at the other end. Go slay them. Slay them for our lord!

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-a.text: Nice job killing those Paladins. You're much closer to his side now. Perhaps you could kill those dwarves as well. That would really please him.

steps.text: Iban is our father, our guide. Soon he will rule all life.

steps.speaker: Disciple of Iban

steps.speaker: Disciple of Iban
steps.text: Hail the great one, my lord Iban. I die for you again and again.

steps.speaker: Disciple of Iban
steps.text: Under Iban anything is possible. Death is only the beginning.

steps.speaker: Disciple of Iban

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.text: Back away! Back away! Wait... you're human!

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.text: Well good luck with that. We came here as miners, completely unaware of the evil that lurked here. There's no way through, not while Iban still rules. He controls the gateway, the only way to the other side.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.text: The Well of Voyage. It acts as a portal through the last section of the caverns. It's the only way into the west. Iban has corrupted it though. Now he uses it to dispose of those who displease him.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.player: Well I'll just have to kill him then.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.text: Ha! Good luck with that. If we knew how, we'd have slain him already.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.text: Seek out the witch, his guide, his only confidante. Only she knows how to rid us of Iban.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof.text: She lives on the platforms above, we dare not go there.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.text: You're brave to come to this place. Not many survive down here.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.text: Don't stay too long traveller. Iban's calls will soon penetrate your delicate human mind.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.text: You'll also become one of his minions... You must go and find the witch Kardia. She holds the secret to Iban's destruction. She lives on the platforms above.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-kamen-ag.text: Too much of this home brew my friend. We make it from plant roots, but it blows your head off.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-kamen-ag.speaker: Kamen
the-underground-pass-talking-to-kamen-ag.text: You don't wanna put it near any naked flames. I've got a barrel full of it here, want some?

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: Here you go... Hic!
You take a sip of brew from Kamen's glass...
...it tastes horrific and burns your throat.

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: Ha ha! I warned you that it's strong stuff. Have a good meal. It may sober you up a bit. I could part with some food for a few coins.
Without enough inventory space:

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: 75 coins pleashe.

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: You'll need to make some room in your inventory first.
Without enough coins:

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: 75 coins pleashe.

steps.player: Oh dear, I haven't enough money...

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: Sorry, I can't just give it away to anyone that walks past.
With enough coins and inventory space:

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: 75 coins pleashe.
The dwarf gives you some food.

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: Enjoy.

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: Well come back any time.

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: Your losh... Hic!

steps.speaker: Kamen
steps.text: Well maybe a good meal? I could part with some food for a few coins.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank.speaker: Klank
the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank.text: Good day to you outsider. You should be careful down here. We're the only ones that haven't yet turned.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank.speaker: Klank
the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank.text: If you're not careful you'll become one of them too!

the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank.speaker: Klank
the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank.text: They're not followers, they're slaves, they're the soulless...

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: They were normal once, adventurers, treasure hunters. But men are weak, they couldn't ignore the voices.

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: Now they all seem to think with one conscience... As if they're being controlled by one being...

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: Maybe... maybe Zamorak himself. Those who try and fight it are locked in cages, until their minds are too weak to resist.

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: Eventually they all fall to his control...
Without having Klank's gauntlets in the inventory:

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: Anyway, I have something that might help you. I crafted these to protect myself from the teeth of the soulless, their bite is vicious.

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: I haven't seen another pair which can withstand their jaws...
Without room in the inventory:
Klank tries to give you some gauntlets but you don't have enough room for them.
With open inventory space:
Klank gives you some gauntlets.

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: No problem traveller. Good luck.

options.text: No wonder their breath is so bad!

steps.player: No wonder their breath is so bad!

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: You think this is funny... Eh?

steps.player: Not really, just trying to lighten up the conversation.

steps.text: Continues above at "Anyway, I have something that might help you."

the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank-un.speaker: Klank
the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank-un.text: Traveller, I hear you plan to destroy Iban?

the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank-un.speaker: Klank
the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank-un.text: I have a gift for you, they may help. I crafted these to protect myself from the teeth of the soulless, their bite is vicious.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank-un.speaker: Klank
the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank-un.text: I haven't seen another pair which can withstand their jaws...

steps.text: Klank tries to give you some gauntlets but you don't have enough room for them.
Klank gives you some gauntlets.

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: Good luck traveller, give Iban a slap for me!

the-underground-pass-attempting-to-open-.text: You try to open the lid of the tomb but it refuses to open.
You hear a strange noise from below.
Inside you hear a witch. She sounds angry.

the-underground-pass-attempting-to-open-.speaker: Kardia
the-underground-pass-attempting-to-open-.text: Blast them dwarves! We need to deal with them!

steps.text: You fill a bucket with dwarf brew.
The barrel is filled with dwarf brew. You don't have anything suitable to hold any in.

the-underground-pass-opening-the-witch-s.text: Inside you hear a witch. It sounds like she's looking for something.

the-underground-pass-opening-the-witch-s.player: That witch probably won't take kindly to me going in there. Maybe I can distract her...

steps.speaker: Witch's cat
steps.text: Miaoww

the-underground-pass-the-witch-s-cat.text: Trying to pick it up with a full inventory:

steps.text: You don't have enough inventory space to hold the cat.

the-underground-pass-the-witch-s-cat.text: Picking it up with inventory space early:

steps.text: You don't have any need to pick the cat up.

steps.speaker: Witch's cat
steps.text: Sssss! Thou art brave to wander so far into the domain of Kardia, mine mistress!

steps.speaker: Witch's cat
steps.text: But soon thou shalt become a soulless servant of Lord Iban, like all who come here.

steps.speaker: Witch's cat
steps.text: Glad shall mine heart be when I see thee prostrate thineself before the altars of Zamorak the Mighty.
The cat runs off and hides.

the-underground-pass-the-witch-s-cat.text: Trying to pick up a second cat:

steps.text: You already have a cat in your inventory. Trying to squeeze another in would just be plain cruel!

the-underground-pass-opening-the-witch-s.text: You place the cat on the floor and then knock on the door...
...the witch takes the cat inside while you hide around the corner.

steps.text: The witch is busy with her cat...
You open the door...
...the witch is busy talking to her cat.

the-underground-pass-distracted-witch.text: Trying to talk to the witch:

steps.text: Kardia is busy talking to her cat.
You search the chest and find a doll, a book and some potions. However, you don't have enough room to take them.

the-underground-pass-opening-the-witch-s.text: With 4 or more inventory spots open:

steps.text: You search the chest and find a doll, a book and some potions.

the-underground-pass-opening-the-witch-s.text: Searching the chest after dropping the doll and/or book while not having any open inventory spaces:

steps.text: You search the chest and find a doll and a book. However, you don't have enough room to take them.

the-underground-pass-opening-the-witch-s.text: Searching the chest after dropping the doll with open inventory spaces:

steps.text: You search the chest and find a doll.

the-underground-pass-opening-the-witch-s.text: Searching the chest after dropping the book with open inventory spaces:

steps.text: You search the chest and find a book.

the-underground-pass-opening-the-witch-s.text: Searching the chest after dropping both the book and doll with only 1 open inventory space:

steps.text: You search the chest and find a doll. The chest also contains a book but you don't have enough room to take it.

the-underground-pass-opening-the-witch-s.text: Searching the chest after dropping both the book and doll with 2 or more open inventory space:

steps.text: You search the chest and find a doll and a book.

the-underground-pass-returning-to-niloof.text: Without the doll of Iban or book:

the-underground-pass-returning-to-niloof.player: I found a strange doll, but I've lost it.

the-underground-pass-returning-to-niloof.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-returning-to-niloof.text: Well it's a good job I found it.

steps.text: With a full inventory:
Niloof tries to give you the doll but you don't have enough room for it.
With open inventory space:
Niloof gives you the doll.

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: I've heard about these dolls. This here be dark magic traveller. They say the witch resurrected Iban from death. She must have used this doll to do it.

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: If this doll created Iban, it can also be his end. Find out what process the witch used to revive him and reverse it. Once that's done, cast it into the Well of Voyage. Iban will be destroyed with it.

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: On the platforms above. Within Iban's foul temple.
With a full inventory:

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: I found this old book as well. It seems to detail how Iban was resurrected. It might hold the information you need to destroy him.
Niloof tries to give you a book but you don't have enough room for it.
With open inventory space:

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: I found this old book by the way. It seems to detail how Iban was resurrected. It might hold the information you need to destroy him.
Niloof gives you a book.

steps.player: Niloof, I found the witch's house.

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: And...?
You show the doll to Niloof.

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: Ah, I've heard about these dolls. This here be dark magic traveller. They say the witch resurrected Iban from death. She must have used this doll to do it.

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: If this doll created Iban, it can also be his end. Find out what process the witch used to revive him and reverse it. Once that's done, cast it into the Well of Voyage. Iban will be destroyed with it.

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: On the platforms above. Within Iban's foul temple.

the-underground-pass-iban-s-tomb.text: Attempting to use dwarf brew on the tomb before reading the history of Iban:

steps.text: You have no reason to do that.

the-underground-pass-iban-s-tomb.text: After reading the history of Iban:

steps.text: You pour the brew over the tomb.

the-underground-pass-iban-s-tomb.text: Attempting to pour brew on the tomb a second time:

steps.text: You have already poured brew over the tomb.
You light the tomb and it bursts into flames.
Without open inventory space:
You search the remains of the tomb and find the ashes of Iban's corpse but you don't have enough room to take them.
With open inventory space:
You search the remains of the tomb and find the ashes of Iban's corpse.

the-underground-pass-iban-s-tomb.text: Searching the tomb while already having Iban's ashes:

steps.text: You have already obtained the flesh of Iban.

the-underground-pass-iban-s-tomb.text: After smearing the ashes on the doll:

steps.text: You try to open the lid of the tomb but it refuses to open.

the-underground-pass-killing-kalrag.text: Before reading the history of Iban:

steps.text: Kalrag slumps to the floor...

the-underground-pass-killing-kalrag.text: After reading the history of Iban and without the doll:

steps.text: Kalrag slumps to the floor...
...poisonous blood flows from the corpse over the soil.
But it seeps away into the earth. You can't collect it without the doll.

the-underground-pass-killing-kalrag.text: After reading the history of Iban and with the doll:

steps.text: Kalrag slumps to the floor...
...poisonous blood flows from the corpse over the soil.
You smear the doll of Iban in the poisoned blood.
You attempt to open the chest but it's magically sealed.
The three amulets glow red so you place them on the chest.
The chest opens and inside you find a strange dark liquid.

the-underground-pass-opening-iban-s-shad.text: Searching again after getting Iban's shadow:

steps.text: The three amulets glow red so you place them on the chest.
The chest opens but it contains nothing.

the-underground-pass-searching-half-soul.text: You search through the bottom of the cage but find nothing.

steps.text: The soulless being bites into your arm.

steps.speaker: Half-soulless
steps.text: Kuluf Ali Monopiate!
The soulless being bites into your arm but Klank's gauntlets protect you.

steps.speaker: Half-soulless
steps.text: Kuluf Ali Monopiate!
You search the cage and find Iban's dove but you don't have enough room to take it.
Without wearing Klank's gauntlets:
While wearing Klank's gauntlets:

the-underground-pass-searching-the-cage-.text: With open inventory space while wearing the gauntlets:

steps.text: You search through the bottom of the cage and find Iban's dove.
The soulless being bites into your arm but Klank's gauntlets protect you.

the-underground-pass-searching-empty-cag.text: You search through the bottom of the cage but find nothing.

the-underground-pass-smearing-the-doll-a.text: You smear the ashes onto the doll.

the-underground-pass-smearing-the-doll-d.text: You smear the remains of the dove onto the doll.

the-underground-pass-smearing-the-doll-s.text: You pour the strange liquid over the doll.
Blood has been smeared onto the doll.
Crushed bones have been spread onto the doll.
Burnt ash has been smeared onto the doll.
A dark liquid has been smeared onto the doll.

the-underground-pass-entering-iban-s-tem.text: Before reading the history of Iban:

steps.text: You have no reason to go in there.

the-underground-pass-entering-iban-s-tem.text: After reading the history of Iban:

steps.text: You should wait until you have the finished doll before going in there.
The door refuses to open. Only followers of Zamorak may enter.

the-underground-pass-entering-iban-s-tem.text: While wearing Zamorak robes with the finished doll:

steps.text: You pull open the large doors...
...and enter the temple.

steps.speaker: Iban
steps.text: The doll? You mean to destroy Iban? No! I am the son of Zamorak! I can't die! And you... You are his slave now! Even if you kill me you will hear his calls forever! You have already fallen!

steps.speaker: Iban
steps.text: You dare to defy me?
You pull open the large doors...
...and walk out of the temple
The door refuses to open.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.text: Traveller, thank the stars you're still around! I thought your time had come.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.player: I've still a few years in me yet.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.text: If the player lost the doll:

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: I found something I think you need traveller...

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: I found it while slaying some of the soulless. Here you go.
With a full inventory:
Niloof tries to give you the doll but you don't have enough room for it.
With open inventory space:
Niloof gives you the doll.
If the player also lost the book:

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: I found this old book as well. It seems to detail how Iban was resurrected. It might hold the information you need to destroy him.
With a full inventory:
Niloof tries to give you a book but you don't have enough room for it.
With open inventory space:
Niloof gives you a book.

steps.speaker: Niloof
steps.text: Good luck to you, you'll need it.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank-ag.speaker: Klank
the-underground-pass-talking-to-klank-ag.text: Hello again adventurer, so you're still around?

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: Well..yes, but they're not cheap to make. I'll have to sell you a pair...

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: 5,000 coins.

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: We don't joke down here friend...

options.text: Okay then, I'll take a pair.

steps.player: Okay then, I'll take a pair.

steps.text: Without enough coins:

steps.player: Oh dear, I haven't got enough money...

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: Sorry, I can't sell them any cheaper than that.

steps.speaker: Klank
steps.text: You too adventurer...

steps.speaker: Iban
steps.text: I am the great Iban, I cannot die!

steps.speaker: Iban
steps.text: You will die, frail mortal!

steps.speaker: Iban
steps.text: Fool!

steps.speaker: Iban
steps.text: I'll swallow your soul!

steps.speaker: Iban
steps.text: You belong in the slave pits!

steps.speaker: Iban
steps.text: Begone from my temple!
The Well of Voyage has been corrupted by Iban.

the-underground-pass-the-well-of-voyage.text: Throwing the doll into the well:

steps.text: You throw the doll of Iban into the pit.
A huge roar comes from the well as the temple starts to collapse.
You're thrown from the temple platform and down into the depths...
You land in a cave. Iban's staff lands next to you. You pick it up.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.text: Adventurer, where am I? I can't remember a thing!

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.player: We were losing you to Iban's influence...

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.text: What? Of course, the voices... But they've stopped. What happened?

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.text: You've done well! Thank you for saving me.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.text: But what about you, adventurer? Did the voices not affect you?
Your mind is filled with strange images. A unicorn. A boulder. Some paladins. They seem real... but were they?

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.text: I see. Well we must now inform the king. Follow me, I'll lead you out.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.player: At last! I've had enough of these caves.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik.text: Koftik leads you back through the winding caverns to the entrance. But it feels like part of you has been left behind...

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.player: Thanks for showing me the way out Koftik.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.text: Always a pleasure. Have you informed the king about Iban?

the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.speaker: Koftik
the-underground-pass-talking-to-koftik-o.text: This is no time to linger. The King must know that Iban is dead. This is a truly historical moment for Ardougne.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.text: Traveller, thank the stars you're still around! I thought your time had come.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.player: I've still a few years in me yet. So what are you still doing down here?

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.speaker: Niloof
the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.text: Well with Iban and his lot gone, we've been left with a great cavern filled with resources. We thought we'd actually do what we came here for and get mining.

the-underground-pass-talking-to-niloof-a.player: Fair enough. Well you take care of yourselves.

finishing-up.player: Indeed, the quest is complete. I have defeated Iban and his minions.

finishing-up.speaker: King Lathas
finishing-up.text: Incredible, you are a true warrior. So do we now have a way through to the west?

finishing-up.player: Not quite. The portal through the last section of the pass has been damaged. It will need repairing.

finishing-up.speaker: King Lathas
finishing-up.text: I see. I will send our best mages in at once. Once they have made the repairs, we will finally be ready to stop King Tyras.

finishing-up.speaker: King Lathas
finishing-up.text: For now, I thank you for your help adventurer. Your loyalty is an inspiration to all.

finishing-up.player: So how long do you think the repairs will take?

finishing-up.speaker: King Lathas
finishing-up.text: It shouldn't take the mages long at all. Once their work is done we will finally be ready to move against my brother.

options.text: I assume you have a plan?

steps.player: I assume you have a plan?

steps.text: If the player does not have the requirements for Regicide:

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I do indeed. However, I fear you are not yet ready to carry it out. Return to me when you are and we will begin.
Unknown condition:

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I do indeed. However, I worry you might not be ready to carry it out. Are you sure you're up for it?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Very well. Now, I recently managed to make contact with the elves that inhabit the western lands.
Continues below from "Elves? I've never seen an elf before."

options.text: I don't think I'm ready yet.

steps.player: I don't think I'm ready yet.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Very well. Return to me when you are and we will begin.
If the player has the requirements for Regicide:

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I do indeed. I recently managed to make contact with the elves that inhabit the western lands.

steps.player: Elves? I've never seen an elf before.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Well that may well change soon. Apparently, my brother has been causing them quite a bit of trouble. As such, they've agreed to help us get rid of him once and for all.

steps.player: So what do I need to do?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: You are to head into the Underground Pass and through the Well of Voyage. The mages should have it repaired by the time you arrive.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Once you are through, you will be met by some representatives of Lord Iorwerth.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: With their help, you are to find my brother and kill him. Once that's done, return to me.
Continues in Transcript:Regicide

steps.player: Actually, I don't think I'm ready for this yet.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: As you wish. Return to me when you are ready and we will begin.

options.text: What's the deal with your brother again?

steps.player: What's the deal with your brother again?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: My brother, King Tyras, was always a bit of an explorer. He went on numerous expeditions to the lands west of here. On one of these expeditions, he was captured by the forces of the Dark Lord.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: The Dark Lord agreed to spare his life, but only on one condition... That he would drink from the Chalice of Eternity. The chalice corrupted him. He joined forces with the Dark Lord, the embodiment of pure evil...

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: As a result, I had a wall built around West Ardougne to act as a barrier between him and the rest of the world. Tyras is king of West Ardougne, sealing off the city was the only way to stop him and the Dark Lord.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I knew people would never believe the truth, so I had the plague made up as an excuse for the cordon. I'm not proud of it, but it was the only way to keep people safe.

steps.player: But now we're ready to stop him.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Indeed we are. My brother has been gathering strength in the west, preparing to move against us. But now that we have a way through, we can move against him first.

options.text: Excellent. Do you have a plan in place?

steps.text: Continues above after "I assume you have a plan?"

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Farewell adventurer. Return to me once you are ready to begin.

finishing-up-talking-to-king-lathas-agai.player: Good day my liege. Any progress with the Well of Voyage?

finishing-up-talking-to-king-lathas-agai.speaker: King Lathas
finishing-up-talking-to-king-lathas-agai.text: Ahh... adventurer. The repair work on the Well of Voyage has been completed. We're finally ready to move against my brother.

options.text: I assume you have a plan?
What's the deal with your brother again?
